$comment: The README's pictures in docs/, made by Make-Screenshots.ps1 from the game's ScreenshotTour (#269). Sizes and crops are in pixels of a 1280x720 screen; scale gives more pixels per one of those. tolerance is the share of pixels that may change from run to run (1% by default): the pictures from inside a game have animated bosses, measured at up to 10% (arrival), 6% (line-up) and 13% (tier look) between two runs.
